title: Aftersun
reviewTitle: Memory reconstructed through MiniDV camcorder grain
reviewBody: An extraordinary debut that captures the fragile gap between how we experienced childhood moments and how we understand our parents decades later. Every frame feels deliberate yet unforced.

title: Severance
reviewTitle: Brutalist corporate symmetry and clinical tension
reviewBody: A masterwork of production design and pacing. The fluorescent corridors of Lumon Industries turn workplace alienation into a gripping sci-fi thriller where every wide-angle frame carries weight.

title: Balatro
reviewTitle: A masterclass in emergent systems design and tactile UI feedback
reviewBody: Beneath the poker aesthetic lies one of the cleanest multiplicative synergy engines in modern roguelike design. Its CRT shaders, sound cues, and pacing make every hand feel consequential.

title: In Rainbows
reviewTitle: Warm polyrhythms and timeless production clarity
reviewBody: Nearly two decades on, the interlocking guitar arpeggios and crisp drum transients on In Rainbows remain my benchmark for studio warmth and emotional directness.
